title: Disclaimer
paragraph:
This website is personally created and administered by the founder of Anitism; with a sole purpose of educational and religious purposes. Content on this website is merely for educational and religious purposes and should not be viewed for anything other than its original intent. As much as possible, the intention here is to present and preserve any verifiable and reliable data of the Anitism religion, based on a few available as well as accessible primary sources for the study of the Anitism religion.
The founder of Anitism: Francis B. van Balkom, aims to limit opinions or own interpretations so as not to feed biases in presenting and preserving the life, culture, and events of the past. Any data on this website is accurate and true to the best of the founder his knowledge, but there maybe ommissions, error, mistakes or stated facts that may need updating or further verifications through information from recent research findings. It is highly encouraged for a reader to do continuous corroboration of the data recorded on the website to other established online source or to printed books and publications. To reiterate, all of the posts published on the website are for educational and religious purpose only. The contents of the website are based solely on the extensive research and readings done mostly throughout the internet and literature. This website is created on the grounds of freedom of religion and beliefs.
If you wish to use, publicate, replicate or reconstruct content of my website elsewhere, create a referral to my website. Copyright © Anitism (Francis B. van Balkom). All rights reserved.
